ops.para: #308 lane L, by s308-D25 (Dave 2026-09-29 12:08 BST, verbatim: "Common is legacy - its how we should label it in any interfaces, we can rename or alias it, whatever is the best solutio"): 'Common' in s308-D2 means the theme whose id is `legacy`. So the chosen mark is red in Supercharge and Legacy/Common, and black in Console and Mono. The builder need not ask which theme 'Common' names; it is `legacy` (attr `legacy`, label 'Common' in every interface). Words: notes/_lanes/308/DAVE-WORDS-2026-09-29-1208.md.
